scope: Per-engine custom storage readiness covers dispatch through complete batch/round publication; interrupted raw engines require source replay and Session reconstructs independent fresh state.
trackedSchemeDigestFormat: Sorted tracked .ss paths; UTF-8 path + NUL + content SHA256 + newline

counterexample.observedAfterMutationAndFailure: Raw retained engine run returned successfully with private state already marking the unpublished fact
counterexample.expectedAfterMutationAndFailure: ASCENT storage state requires source replay
counterexample.qualification: Rejected native result; original raised error and private mutation were checked before unsafe engine reuse. The final suite retains this case and adds Session/late-guard controls.

discriminators: Raised dispatch, wrong shape, field checker and output budget failures propagate original diagnostics and revoke raw engine reuse
Fresh engines accept the same fact that interrupted private state could suppress
Session source reconstruction recovers all four failure modes and preserves prior results
A successful custom injection followed by a later guard failure keeps the entire rule round tentative
Repeated injections inside a round remain legal and become ready only after its full commit
Prior spine ownership, malformed packet exclusion, native direct dispatch, duplicate order, budgets and BYODS composition pass

paper.locator: Sections 3.1 and 3.3: injection and total/delta concretization
paper.transfer: Exception recovery must not reuse private state whose recorded facts did not cross the evaluator publication boundary.
paper.boundary: Scheme readiness/replay protocol; not arbitrary Provider rollback or a new DLDS theorem.

cost: One private readiness record per custom relation state; public run/append and completed rule rounds traverse custom owners. Native state values remain unchanged.
remaining: Independent fresh state construction is a Provider premise
